series: Climate Fiscal Policy Brief No. 7.1 · October 2026
title: Read the Excise Schedule Whole, Against the Damage It Should Price

slides.title: Read the Excise Schedule Whole, Against the Damage It Should Price
slides.subtitle: The Excise-Fiscal Diagnostic, and what it finds in Sierra Leone and Liberia
slides.message: A repeatable report puts every excise line on one scale and sets fuel taxes against one fixed set of damage values. Run on two 2026 schedules, it finds light fuel taxes, inconsistent alcohol taxes and weak collection of health excises.
slides.author: Stephen J. Stretton · writing in a personal capacity

slides.title: Excises are a government's main price tools for damage, yet few ministries read the schedule whole

slides.text: Schedules grow by amendment for decades. Each change made sense; together they rarely add up to a policy anyone chose, and fixed-amount rates erode until a large, unpopular catch-up.
slides.source: OECD/AUC/ATAF, Revenue Statistics in Africa 2025 (excises, category 5121; author's calculation, unweighted mean); Excise-Fiscal Diagnostic (2026); working paper 7.1.

slides.title: The diagnostic maps every line onto 30 standard lines and measures each rate three ways

points.text: energy, health and gambling, luxury, telecoms, financial, inputs, resources. A line with no purpose shows up as one.
with fixed units: a liter of fuel, a pack of 20, a liter of pure alcohol. The tenth country compares with the first.
compares countries; share of the consumer price serves health targets; revenue as % of GDP shows budget weight.
the real value of each specific rate since its last change, year by year from 2020.
each gap comes with a range; how far and how fast to close it is for government.

slides.title: Fuel taxes are set against one fixed set of damage values; health taxes against WHO targets

points.text: carbon + local air pollution + share of fuel response from driving less × (congestion + accidents + road damage).
carbon USD 50/t (social-cost case USD 185/t), one value of a statistical life rule, mileage share 0.5.
excise at least 70% of retail price (WHO). Alcohol: consistency per liter of pure alcohol. Sugary drinks: price rise of 20% or more.
where fuel also pays for the state, the right tax is above the damage it causes.

slides.source: Parry et al. (2014); Parry and Small (2005); Rennert et al. (2022); WHO (2016, 2021, 2023).

slides.text: Language models often state legal facts wrongly and cannot tell when they do. The review is the method, not an add-on: the time saved is in reading, converting and laying out; checking cannot be skipped.
